subject.title: feat: include provider/model/profile/trigger context in overloaded and rate limit error messages

question: Should OpenClaw expose provider/model/profile=active/trigger context in shared chat transient-error replies, and require the refreshed branch to preserve authMode before merge?
rationale: The code defect is mechanical, but the delivered diagnostic boundary is a user-visible product choice for shared channels and provider/auth metadata.

options.title: Refresh And Preserve AuthMode
options.body: Carry authMode, profileId, and trigger together through formatter, failover, payload, lifecycle, and runner call sites before any merge.

options.title: Narrow Delivered Diagnostics
options.body: Deliver only provider/model to chat and keep profile presence or trigger in logs/lifecycle metadata if shared-channel exposure is too broad.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it later if maintainers decide transient provider context should not be added to core channel-visible copy.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Preserve AuthMode
recommendation.body: Carry authMode, profileId, and trigger together through formatter, failover, payload, lifecycle, and runner call sites before any merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current authMode billing contract and are the clearest owner for whether this PR may overlap that provider/auth behavior.
